CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION e34_private.affiliate_catalog_gaps(search_text text DEFAULT ''::text, after_number text DEFAULT NULL::text, after_id text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare results jsonb;begin
 if not e34_private.commercial_admin() then raise exception 'Administrator permission and MFA required';end if;
 if char_length(search_text)>120 or (after_number is not null and after_number !~ '^[0-9]{11}$') or (after_id is not null and char_length(after_id)>200) or ((after_id is null)<>(after_number is null)) then raise exception 'Invalid catalog queue search';end if;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)),'[]'::jsonb) into results from(
  select p.id,p.name,p.number_normalized,
   (select count(*) from e34_private.affiliate_match_reviews r where r.part_id=p.id and r.review_status='pending') as pending_candidates,
   (select count(*) from e34_private.affiliate_match_reviews r where r.part_id=p.id and r.review_status='rejected') as rejected_candidates
  from public.parts p where p.number_normalized is not null
  and not exists(select 1 from e34_private.affiliate_match_reviews r where r.part_id=p.id and r.review_status='approved')
  and (after_number is null or (p.number_normalized,p.id)>(after_number,after_id))
  and (trim(search_text)='' or p.number_normalized=regexp_replace(search_text,'[^0-9]','','g') or to_tsvector('simple',p.name||' '||coalesce(p.number_normalized,'')) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('simple',search_text))
  order by p.number_normalized,p.id limit 26
 )x;
 return jsonb_build_object('rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(value) from jsonb_array_elements(results) with ordinality x(value,n) where n<=25),'[]'::jsonb),'has_more',jsonb_array_length(results)>25,'next_number',case when jsonb_array_length(results)>25 then results->24->>'number_normalized' end,'next_id',case when jsonb_array_length(results)>25 then results->24->>'id' end);
end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION e34_private.public_affiliate_offers(canonical_part_id text, source_position_id text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)),'[]'::jsonb) from(
 select o.id,l.id as link_id,m.name as retailer,p.title,i.value as matched_identifier,r.kind,r.compatibility_notes,r.source_url,r.reviewed_at as match_reviewed_at,
 case when o.price_authorized and o.price_observed_at<=now() and o.price_valid_until>now() then o.price_cents end as price_cents,o.currency,
 case when o.availability_authorized and o.availability_observed_at<=now() and o.availability_valid_until>now() then o.availability end as availability,
 case when o.price_authorized and o.price_observed_at<=now() and o.price_valid_until>now() then o.price_observed_at end as price_observed_at,
 case when o.availability_authorized and o.availability_observed_at<=now() and o.availability_valid_until>now() then o.availability_observed_at end as availability_observed_at,
 case when o.shipping_authorized and o.shipping_observed_at<=now() and o.shipping_valid_until>now() then o.shipping_information end as shipping_information,
 case when p.image_authorized then p.image_url end as image_url
 from e34_private.merchant_offers o join e34_private.affiliate_match_reviews r on r.id=o.match_id join e34_private.merchant_products p on p.id=r.product_id join e34_private.affiliate_merchants m on m.id=p.merchant_id join e34_private.affiliate_programs a on a.id=m.program_id join e34_private.affiliate_links l on l.id=o.link_id
 left join lateral(select value from e34_private.merchant_product_identifiers where product_id=p.id order by case when scheme='bmw_oem' and value=(select number_normalized from public.parts where id=r.matched_part_id) then 0 when scheme='manufacturer_part' then 1 else 2 end,id limit 1)i on true
 where r.part_id=canonical_part_id and (r.scope_position_id is null or r.scope_position_id=source_position_id) and r.review_status='approved' and r.kind in ('exact_verified','verified_replacement','conditional') and o.published and m.active and a.status='approved' and (a.expires_at is null or a.expires_at>now()) and l.active and l.check_status='ok' and l.last_checked_at>=now()-interval '30 days' and (l.expires_at is null or l.expires_at>now()) and l.product_id=p.id and l.destination_url=p.product_url
 and coalesce(e34_private.commercial_url_host(l.destination_url)=any(m.allowed_hosts),false) and coalesce(e34_private.commercial_url_host(l.tracking_url)=any(a.tracking_hosts),false)
 and not exists(select 1 from regexp_split_to_table(split_part(l.tracking_url,'?',2),'&') q where q<>'' and not(split_part(q,'=',1)=any(a.query_parameters)))
 and (r.scope_position_id is null or exists(select 1 from public.part_assembly_positions where id=r.scope_position_id and part_id=r.part_id and active))
 and (r.basis='documented_equivalent' or (r.basis='oem_identity' and r.part_id=r.matched_part_id and exists(select 1 from e34_private.merchant_product_identifiers z join public.parts b on b.id=r.part_id and b.number_normalized=z.value where z.product_id=p.id and z.scheme='bmw_oem')) or (r.basis='direct_supersession' and exists(select 1 from public.part_supersessions z where z.id=r.direct_supersession_id and z.previous_part_id=r.part_id and z.replacement_part_id=r.matched_part_id and z.position_id=r.scope_position_id and (z.conditions='[]'::jsonb or r.kind='conditional')) and exists(select 1 from e34_private.merchant_product_identifiers z join public.parts b on b.id=r.matched_part_id and b.number_normalized=z.value where z.product_id=p.id and z.scheme='bmw_oem')))
 and char_length(canonical_part_id)<=200 and (source_position_id is null or char_length(source_position_id)<=200)
 order by m.name,o.id limit 20)x;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.catalog_find_parts(search_query text, context_filter text DEFAULT NULL::text, max_results integer DEFAULT 31, after_number text DEFAULT NULL::text, after_position text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(position_id text, part_id text, number_normalized text, name text, assembly_id text, assembly_title text, context_id text, context_name text, reference text, required_quantity integer, conditions jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql

 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ with term as materialized(select websearch_to_tsquery('simple',search_query) as query,regexp_replace(search_query,'[^0-9]','','g') as number where char_length(btrim(search_query)) between 2 and 200), matched as materialized(select p.id from public.parts p,term t where p.number_normalized=t.number or to_tsvector('simple',p.name||' '||coalesce(p.number_normalized,'')) @@ t.query union select pos.part_id from public.part_assembly_positions pos,term t where pos.active and (context_filter is null or pos.context_id=context_filter) and to_tsvector('simple',pos.source_name) @@ t.query) select x.id,p.id,p.number_normalized,x.source_name,a.id,a.title,c.id,c.name,x.reference,x.required_quantity,x.conditions from matched m join public.parts p on p.id=m.id join public.part_assembly_positions x on x.part_id=p.id join public.assemblies a on a.id=x.assembly_id join public.vehicle_catalog_contexts c on c.id=x.context_id where x.active and (context_filter is null or c.id=context_filter) and ((after_number is null and after_position is null) or (p.number_normalized,x.id)>(after_number,after_position)) order by p.number_normalized,x.id limit least(greatest(max_results,1),101); $function$

functions.name: catalog_search_parts
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.catalog_search_parts(search_query text, max_results integer DEFAULT 40)
 RETURNS TABLE(position_id text, part_id text, number_normalized text, name text, assembly_id text, assembly_title text, context_id text, context_name text, reference text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with term as materialized (
  select websearch_to_tsquery('simple',search_query) as query,regexp_replace(search_query,'[^0-9]','','g') as number
  where char_length(btrim(search_query)) between 2 and 200
 ), matched as (
  select p.id from public.parts p,term t where p.number_normalized=t.number or to_tsvector('simple',p.name||' '||coalesce(p.number_normalized,'')) @@ t.query
  union
  select x.part_id from public.part_assembly_positions x,term t where x.active and to_tsvector('simple',x.source_name) @@ t.query
 ), candidates as materialized (
  select p.*,p.number_normalized=t.number as exact_number,ts_rank_cd(to_tsvector('simple',p.name),t.query) as rank
  from matched m join public.parts p on p.id=m.id cross join term t
  where p.number_normalized is not null
  order by exact_number desc,rank desc,p.number_normalized
  limit least(greatest(max_results,1),60)
 )
 select x.id,p.id,p.number_normalized,coalesce(x.source_name,p.name),x.assembly_id,a.title,x.context_id,c.name,x.reference
 from candidates p
 left join lateral(select pos.* from public.part_assembly_positions pos where pos.part_id=p.id and pos.active order by pos.context_id,pos.assembly_id,pos.reference,pos.id limit 1) x on true
 left join public.assemblies a on a.id=x.assembly_id
 left join public.vehicle_catalog_contexts c on c.id=x.context_id
 order by p.exact_number desc,p.rank desc,p.number_normalized;
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.support_service_reconcile(message uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare e record;begin
 for e in select * from e34_private.support_events where provider_id=(select provider_id from public.support_messages where id=message) and event_type<>'email.received' order by occurred_at loop
 update public.support_messages set delivery_status=case e.event_type when 'email.sent' then 'sent' when 'email.delivered' then 'delivered' when 'email.delivery_delayed' then 'delayed' when 'email.failed' then 'failed' when 'email.bounced' then 'bounced' when 'email.complained' then 'complained' when 'email.suppressed' then 'suppressed' else delivery_status end,delivery_updated_at=e.occurred_at where id=message and(delivery_updated_at is null or delivery_updated_at<=e.occurred_at) and not(delivery_status in('bounced','complained','suppressed') and e.event_type in('email.sent','email.delivery_delayed','email.delivered'));end loop;
 if exists(select 1 from public.support_messages m join public.support_tickets t on t.id=m.ticket_id where m.id=message and m.delivery_status='delivered' and t.is_test and t.user_id is not null) then update e34_private.support_configuration set outbound_verified_at=now() where id;end if;
end;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.support_staff_list(filter_status text DEFAULT 'open'::text, search_text text DEFAULT ''::text, unread_only boolean DEFAULT false, before_time timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, before_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if not e34_private.support_admin() then raise exception 'Administrator permission and authenticator required' using errcode='42501';end if;
 if filter_status not in('open','closed','spam','all','deleted') or length(search_text)>200 then raise exception 'Invalid filter';end if;
 return jsonb_build_object('tickets',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q)),'[]'::jsonb) from(
 select t.id,t.reference,t.contact_name,t.email,t.subject,t.category,t.status,t.created_at,t.updated_at,t.last_customer_at,t.last_customer_message_id,t.closed_at,t.deleted_at,(r.user_id is null or r.seen_customer_message is distinct from t.last_customer_message_id) unread,
 (select count(*) from public.support_messages m where m.ticket_id=t.id and m.delivery_status in('failed','bounced','uncertain','suppressed')) delivery_problems
 from public.support_tickets t left join public.support_reads r on r.ticket_id=t.id and r.user_id=auth.uid()
 where (case when filter_status='deleted' then t.deleted_at is not null else t.deleted_at is null end)
 and (filter_status in('all','deleted') or t.status=filter_status)
 and (search_text='' or t.subject ilike '%'||search_text||'%' or t.email ilike '%'||search_text||'%' or t.contact_name ilike '%'||search_text||'%' or t.reference ilike '%'||search_text||'%' or exists(select 1 from public.support_messages m where m.ticket_id=t.id and to_tsvector('simple',m.body)@@websearch_to_tsquery('simple',search_text)))
 and (not unread_only or r.user_id is null or r.seen_customer_message is distinct from t.last_customer_message_id)
 and (before_time is null or(t.updated_at,t.id)<(before_time,before_id))
 order by t.updated_at desc,t.id desc limit 31)q));
end;$function$
